fah-436.title: Vegetable Crepe
fah-436.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-436.culturalNotes: Add any other vegetables as desired. Serve the crepe with tomato sauce or white sauce.

instructions.1: Mix the warm milk with the sugar and yeast, cover, and set aside for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Mix the potatoes with the black pepper, salt, and thyme.
instructions.3: Add the warm milk and yeast mixture to the potatoes and mix well.
instructions.4: Add the flour and baking powder and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the oil and mix the dough well.
instructions.6: Add the cheese, tomatoes, olives, peppers, and finely diced sausage; mix well.
instructions.7: Heat a pan over medium heat and grease with a little oil.
instructions.8: Pour a ladleful of batter into the pan and spread it evenly.
instructions.9: Leave until cooked on one side, then flip to the other side.
instructions.10: Place cheese on half the crepe and fold it closed.
instructions.11: Repeat until all the batter is used.

fah-437.title: One-Pot Koshari
fah-437.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-437.culturalNotes: Make sure the lentils soak for an hour before cooking. Reduce the quantities for fewer servings. Koshari keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Slice the white onion thinly, add the salt and starch, and toss well.
instructions.2: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat, add the onion, and stir until browned.
instructions.3: Lift the browned onion onto paper towels and spread the pieces apart.
instructions.4: In a small pot, add a little oil and sauté the minced garlic until golden.
instructions.5: Add the pureed tomatoes, red pepper, instant stock, sugar, tomato sauce, cumin, black pepper, and dried coriander; stir well.
instructions.6: Add a cup of boiling water and let the sauce simmer until thickened.
instructions.7: In the same oil, add the vermicelli and stir until lightly browned.
instructions.8: Add the rice and toss with the vermicelli until lightly toasted.
instructions.9: Add the lentils (soaked for an hour) with their boiling water, then stir everything together.
instructions.10: Add the small pasta and toss with the rest of the ingredients.
instructions.11: Add boiling water to cover the ingredients by about 2 cm, then leave over high heat until boiling.
instructions.12: Stir well, cover the pot, and leave over low heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.13: In a pan, combine the water, minced garlic, minced pepper, hot pepper, cumin, dried coriander, salt, vinegar, and lemon juice; bring to a boil.
instructions.14: Remove the duqqa from the heat and pour it into a side bowl.
instructions.15: Serve the koshari hot with the sauce, browned onions, duqqa, and lemon.

fah-438.title: Potato Kofta with Cheese
fah-438.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-438.culturalNotes: Freeze the kofta and use when needed. Leftover chicken or seasoned ground meat can replace the pastrami.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in their skins, then peel and mash them.
instructions.2: Cut the colored peppers into small cubes.
instructions.3: Sauté the pastrami in a spoonful of ghee.
instructions.4: Mix the mashed potatoes with the cheeses, colored peppers, sautéed pastrami, and spices (salt and pepper).
instructions.5: Spread the mixture on parchment paper or a plastic sheet in a tray.
instructions.6: Refrigerate for one hour, or freeze for half an hour.
instructions.7: Cut the mixture into your preferred shapes.
instructions.8: Dip the pieces in flour, then in the egg beaten with starch and milk, then in breadcrumbs.
instructions.9: Fry the kofta in hot oil until golden.
instructions.10: Serve the kofta hot.

fah-439.title: Cheese & Vegetar Kofta
fah-439.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-439.culturalNotes: Any cooked white rice works, and the cheese can be skipped if unavailable. Knorr spicy Vegetar gives a hot flavor.

instructions.1: Mince the boiled chicken well with the salt, black pepper, onion powder, chopped parsley, and chopped green onion.
instructions.2: Add the cooked white rice and knead the ingredients together until combined.
instructions.3: Add the egg and knead again until the mixture holds together.
instructions.4: Shape the kofta into equal balls and tuck a cube of cheese in the center if desired.
instructions.5: Reshape the kofta so the cheese is fully covered.
instructions.6: Place them in a deep dish and dip them in milk.
instructions.7: Coat the kofta in the mixture of breadcrumbs, starch, and Vegetar.
instructions.8: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and add the kofta.
instructions.9: Turn the kofta occasionally until crispy and golden.
instructions.10: Serve the kofta on a bed of parsley.

fah-440.title: One-Pot Kofta with Rice
fah-440.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-440.culturalNotes: Any rice works, but Toledo rice gives a distinctive flavor. Add a squeeze of lemon for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Mix the ground meat with the starch, salt, black pepper, seven-spice, and grated onion.
instructions.2: Knead the mixture well until it holds together.
instructions.3: Shape the kofta into small balls.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a large pot, add the kofta, and leave until browned on all sides.
instructions.5: Remove the kofta from the pot and set aside on a plate.
instructions.6: Add the mushrooms, onion, sugar, and carrots to the pot and leave until well sautéed.
instructions.7: Add the raisins, spices, salt, black pepper, cinnamon stick, and instant stock; stir well.
instructions.8: Soak the rice in water for half an hour, then drain.
instructions.9: Add the rice to the pot and toss with the mixture.
instructions.10: Add the kofta back to the pot and pour in boiling water until the rice and kofta are covered.
instructions.11: Cover the pot and place over high heat until the water boils.
instructions.12: Stir the rice and kofta once, then cover the pot again and lower the heat.
instructions.13: Leave the pot over low heat until the rice is cooked and set.
instructions.14: Serve the kofta with rice hot, garnished with fresh coriander.

fah-441.title: Spicy Kofta with Baked Potatoes & Soft Flatbread
fah-441.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-441.culturalNotes: Store the bread in a sealed plastic bag in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve the sandwiches with tomato sauce or hot sauce as desired.

instructions.1: Make the bread dough: mix the flour, yeast, salt, sugar, and milk powder in a bowl. Add the warm water gradually and knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and let rise.
instructions.2: Prepare the potatoes: wash the potatoes well and cut them in half. Boil in salted water until half-cooked. In another bowl, mix the oil, onion powder, garlic powder, thyme, paprika, salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and chili. Toss the potatoes in the mixture well.
instructions.3: Prepare the kofta: mix the ground meat, minced onion, and kofta mix in a bowl. Process briefly in the food processor. Shape the kofta into patties.
instructions.4: Bake the bread: roll the dough out on a floured surface to under half a centimeter thick. Cut to the desired size and place on a griddle. Bake in a hot oven until cooked.
instructions.5: Grill the kofta in the oven at high heat until cooked.
instructions.6: Bake the potatoes in the oven at high heat until cooked and crispy.
instructions.7: Make the salad: dice the tomatoes, onion, and bell pepper into small cubes. Add the duqqa dressing and mix well.
instructions.8: Assemble the sandwiches: open the bread and fill it with the cooked kofta, crispy potatoes, and salad.

fah-442.title: Savory Cake
fah-442.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-442.culturalNotes: Add pastrami or diced chicken breast to the batter for extra flavor. Serve hot or cold — perfect for breakfast or dinner.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with the sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the half cup of oil and the buttermilk or yogurt; mix well.
instructions.3: In another bowl, mix the flour with the baking powder.
instructions.4: Add the flour mixture gradually to the egg mixture and mix until combined.
instructions.5: Add half the olives and half the diced cheese to the batter and mix well.
instructions.6: Pour the batter into a tray greased with oil and dusted with flour.
instructions.7: Scatter the remaining olives and cheese over the top.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C.
instructions.9: Bake for 30 minutes or until golden.
instructions.10: Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.

fah-443.title: Pizza-Flavored Lunchbox
fah-443.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-443.culturalNotes: Add any other ingredients like mushrooms or sweet peppers. The portions keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into cubes and brown them.
instructions.2: Dice the bell pepper and add it to the potatoes.
instructions.3: Add the ground meat or turkey with the thyme and garlic powder.
instructions.4: Add the pizza sauce, ketchup, and mozzarella; toss well.
instructions.5: Fill cupcake cups with the potato mixture and arrange on a tray.
instructions.6: Bake at the highest temperature for 10 minutes until the cheese melts.
instructions.7: In a bowl, mix the milk, oil, egg, salt, and sugar.
instructions.8: Add the pizza mix, baking powder, thyme, olives, and meat; mix well.
instructions.9: Fill the cupcake cups two-thirds full with the muffin batter and arrange on a tray.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.11: Sprinkle nigella seeds on top before baking.
instructions.12: In a bowl, mix the pizza sauce, ketchup, onion powder, garlic powder, and thyme.
instructions.13: Brush the tortilla with the mixture and add the meat or turkey and mozzarella.
instructions.14: Roll the tortilla and cut it into slices.

fah-444.title: Fino Bread Muffins with Vegetables & Cheese
fah-444.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-444.culturalNotes: Add any ingredients you like to make the muffins more varied and nutritious. Perfect for breakfast or a snack.

instructions.1: Cut the fino bread into small cubes.
instructions.2: Add the half cup of milk, the butter, the cream cheese, salt, black pepper, and thyme. Toss well.
instructions.3: Add the diced bread to the mixture.
instructions.4: Add your favorite vegetables (colored peppers, parsley, olives), meats (pastrami, turkey pieces), and shredded cheese. Toss well.
instructions.5: Fill the muffin molds with the mixture. You can also use one baking tray greased with butter or ghee and dusted with flour.
instructions.6: Place the molds in a preheated oven at 180°C.
instructions.7: Bake the muffins for 20 minutes or until golden.
instructions.8: Serve the muffins hot with your favorite drink.

fah-445.title: Savory Muffins
fah-445.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-445.culturalNotes: Add different cheeses like Rumi or mozzarella. Use up leftover cheese from the fridge.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with the salt and black pepper in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the vinegar and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the oil and milk and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the baking powder and flour and stir until the batter is smooth.
instructions.5: Add the tomatoes, olives, parsley, and cheese; mix well.
instructions.6: Add the chicken, meat, or pastrami pieces if desired.
instructions.7: Fill the muffin molds with the batter.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 10–15 minutes.
instructions.9: Test the muffins with a toothpick for doneness.

fah-446.title: Potato Crispies
fah-446.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-446.culturalNotes: Serve the crispies with different dips like ketchup or mayonnaise. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in boiling water until tender.
instructions.2: Mash the potatoes while hot.
instructions.3: Add the starch and spices (turmeric, paprika, salt, pepper, chili) to the mashed potatoes and mix well.
instructions.4: Add an extra spoonful of starch if the dough is sticky.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into small cylinders and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.6: Use a fork to make marks on the surface of the pieces.
instructions.7: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.8: Fry the crispies until golden.
instructions.9: Place them on paper towels to absorb excess oil.

fah-447.title: Eggplant & Chicken Maqluba
fah-447.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-447.culturalNotes: Add boiled chickpeas for a heartier dish. Garnish with toasted nuts for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Heat a spoonful of ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Wash the chicken and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.3: Season the chicken with the cinnamon, cloves, black pepper, mastic, cardamom, and bay leaves; toss well.
instructions.4: Add the minced onion, tomato, carrot, sugar, salt, stock cube, and boiling water. Cover the chicken and leave over low heat until cooked.
instructions.5: Meanwhile, peel the eggplant and potatoes and cut them into thick slices.
instructions.6: Add a pinch of salt to the eggplant, toss, and leave in a colander to drain.
instructions.7: Fry the potatoes in hot oil over high heat until golden, then drain.
instructions.8: Fry the eggplant in hot oil until golden, then drain.
instructions.9: Strain the chicken from the broth and brown it in a pot with a spoonful of ghee.
instructions.10: Wash the rice and soak it for 30 minutes, then drain. Season the rice with the salt, black pepper, turmeric, curry, and cinnamon; toss well.
instructions.11: Layer tomato and onion slices on the bottom of the pot, then add a layer of rice, then the chicken, then the eggplant, then the potatoes, then rice again. Repeat the layers until all the ingredients are used.
instructions.12: Add the boiling broth to the pot — about twice the volume of the rice.
instructions.13: Cover the pot over high heat until it boils, then lower the heat and leave until cooked.
instructions.14: Once the rice is done, gently invert the pot onto a serving platter.
instructions.15: Serve the maqluba hot with toasted nuts if desired.

fah-448.title: Chicken Fajita Pasta
fah-448.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-448.culturalNotes: Add a hot pepper if you prefer the dish spicy. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into thin strips.
instructions.2: Marinate the chicken with 1 tablespoon of garlic, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, black pepper, salt, 1 teaspoon of onion powder, 1 teaspoon of garlic powder, and 2 tablespoons of vinegar. Mix well and leave for half an hour.
instructions.3: Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a pot over heat, add the chicken pieces, and stir until cooked.
instructions.4: Slice the onion and colored peppers thinly.
instructions.5: In the same pot, add the onion and colored peppers and stir for 5 minutes until the onion turns golden.
instructions.6: Add the instant stock and 1 tablespoon of flour; stir well.
instructions.7: Add 2 tablespoons of tomato sauce and half a liter of boiling water; stir until the sauce thickens.
instructions.8: Return the chicken to the pot and toss with the vegetables and sauce.
instructions.9: Boil the pasta in boiling water until done, drain, and add it to the pot. Toss over heat for 2–3 minutes.
instructions.10: Serve the dish hot with a sprinkle of fresh coriander.

fah-449.title: Microwave Mac & Cheese
fah-449.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes

instructions.1: Mix the pasta with the water and salt in a microwave-safe bowl.
instructions.2: Microwave the bowl for 2 minutes.
instructions.3: Remove from the microwave, add the milk and cheese mix, and stir well.
instructions.4: Return the bowl to the microwave for 3 more minutes.

fah-450.title: Shrimp Pasta in White Sauce
fah-450.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-450.culturalNotes: Serve hot with a green salad or fresh bread. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Bring water to a boil in a pot, add the salt and oil, then boil the pasta for 6 minutes.
instructions.2: Drain the pasta after boiling.
instructions.3: Cut the celery, dill, colored peppers, and green onion into small pieces.
instructions.4: In another pot, add the shrimp and toss with the minced garlic, celery, and green onion.
instructions.5: Add the flour and stir well until the mixture is dry.
instructions.6: Add some pasta cooking water, the salt, and pepper; stir until the mixture boils.
instructions.7: Add the milk and stir until the sauce is smooth.
instructions.8: Add the pasta to the mixture and toss well.
instructions.9: Pour into a tagine and top with cheese.
instructions.10: Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes.

fah-451.title: Steak & Onion Pasta with a Killer Sauce
fah-451.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-451.culturalNotes: Add cream if you prefer a thicker sauce. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the oil and butter in a pan over high heat.
instructions.2: Add the steak and stir until golden on all sides.
instructions.3: Add the salt and black pepper and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the crushed garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.5: Add the onion and stir until golden and soft.
instructions.6: Add the sugar and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the demi-glace powder and stir well.
instructions.8: Add boiling water and let it boil.
instructions.9: Boil the pasta in salted boiling water for 10 minutes until half-cooked.
instructions.10: Add the pasta to the sauce and stir well.
instructions.11: Add some pasta water to adjust the consistency.
instructions.12: Add the crushed pepper and stir well.

fah-452.title: Chicken Pasta
fah-452.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-452.culturalNotes: Add more peas to taste. Serve with a green salad or fresh bread.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the pasta and brown until golden.
instructions.3: Add the washed, drained chicken pieces and brown until golden.
instructions.4: Add the minced onion and garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.5: Add the cumin, coriander, pepper, and salt; stir well.
instructions.6: Add the peas and pureed tomatoes and let the mixture simmer for 5 minutes.
instructions.7: Add the tomato sauce and instant stock, cover the pot, and let it boil.
instructions.8: After it boils, add the pasta, cover the pot, and let it boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Stir the pasta, cover the pot again, and leave for another 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Add hot pepper to taste and leave for 5 more minutes.
instructions.11: Serve the dish hot.

fah-453.title: Liver Pasta
fah-453.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-453.culturalNotes: Add more spices to taste. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Blend the red pepper, garlic, and tomatoes in the blender or food processor until smooth.
instructions.2: Heat a tray or pot over heat, add a spoonful of ghee and 3 tablespoons of oil. Once hot, add the tomato sauce and the blended tomatoes.
instructions.3: Add the salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, and instant stock. Cover and let the sauce simmer until thickened.
instructions.4: Add boiling water (about one bag's worth). Let the mixture boil, then add the desired amount of pasta.
instructions.5: Adjust the salt if needed, cover the pot, and let it boil. Once boiling, stir the pasta once, lower the heat, and let it cook through.
instructions.6: Slice the liver thinly. Crush 5 garlic cloves with a pinch of salt.
instructions.7: Heat a pan over heat and add 2–3 tablespoons of oil. Once hot, add the garlic and sauté until colored.
instructions.8: Add the liver pieces and stir until they change color. Add the green and hot peppers and stir well.
instructions.9: Season the liver with salt and pepper.
instructions.10: Add a pinch of sugar to the pasta sauce.
instructions.11: Once the pasta is cooked, add the liver to the sauce and stir well.

fah-454.title: One-Pot Pasta
fah-454.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-454.culturalNotes: Increase the sauce quantity to taste. Add more boiling water if the pasta needs more cooking time.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the onion, colored pepper, and chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute.
instructions.3: Add the stock cube, salt, black pepper, cumin, and coriander; stir well.
instructions.4: Add the boiling water, cover the pot, and let it simmer over low heat for 7–10 minutes.
instructions.5: Add the pasta and stir well, then let it boil for 3–5 minutes until cooked.
instructions.6: Remove the pot from the heat and serve hot.

fah-455.title: Shrimp Pasta in White Sauce
fah-455.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-455.culturalNotes: Add chopped green or red pepper for more flavor and color. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Boil water in a pot, add the salt, then add the pasta and leave until cooked.
instructions.2: In a pan, add the oil and butter and let them heat through.
instructions.3: Add the onion and garlic and stir until the onion is golden.
instructions.4: Add the black pepper, chili, and celery; stir well.
instructions.5: Add the fish stock and let it boil.
instructions.6: Add the shrimp and mushrooms and leave until cooked.
instructions.7: Add the cooking cream and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the boiled pasta and toss until coated in the sauce.
instructions.9: Add the chopped dill and stir well.
instructions.10: Serve the dish hot.

fah-456.title: White Sauce Pasta with Chicken Kofta
fah-456.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-456.culturalNotes: Canned mushrooms work if fresh aren't available. Serve with a side salad.

instructions.1: Boil the pasta until two-thirds done.
instructions.2: Mince the chicken breasts in the food processor and add the Knorr kofta mix.
instructions.3: Mix the chicken well with the mix and shape into equal balls.
instructions.4: Heat a pan over heat and add the oil and butter.
instructions.5: Brown the kofta until golden.
instructions.6: Add the minced onion and sauté until wilted and golden.
instructions.7: Add the sliced mushrooms and toss the mixture.
instructions.8: Add the Knorr stock cube, salt, and pepper.
instructions.9: Add half the milk and stir the mixture.
instructions.10: Add the other half of the milk with the Knorr béchamel mix and stir.
instructions.11: Add the kofta to the mixture and leave over medium heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.12: Add the pasta to the mixture and toss well.
instructions.13: Serve the dish garnished with parsley and tomatoes.

fah-457.title: Mini Cheese Sandwiches
fah-457.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-457.culturalNotes: Use different cheeses to taste. If you can't find date molasses, use regular molasses instead.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, butter, warm milk, and water gradually; knead until the dough is cohesive and elastic.
instructions.3: Add a spoonful of oil and mix it in well.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 7–10 minutes until smooth and cohesive.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rise until doubled.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into 20 small balls.
instructions.7: Cover the balls and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Stuff each ball with cheese and seal it well.
instructions.9: Dip each ball in the date molasses, then in toasted sesame.
instructions.10: Flatten them slightly and place on an oiled griddle or tray.
instructions.11: Bake at high heat until golden.
instructions.12: Let them cool, then cover with a clean towel.
instructions.13: Store in plastic bags in the freezer for longer keeping.

fah-458.title: Tender & Crispy Nuggets
fah-458.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-458.culturalNotes: Serve the nuggets with ketchup or mayonnaise. They keep in the freezer for up to a month.

instructions.1: Prepare the crispy coating and crush it lightly.
instructions.2: Put the chicken breasts in the food processor and mince into small pieces.
instructions.3: Add the paprika, black pepper, chili, onion powder, garlic powder, chicken spices, instant bouillon, salt, and starch. Mix the ingredients well.
instructions.4: Add the boiled, cooled potatoes and knead the mixture.
instructions.5: Prepare the egg, starch, salt, and black pepper mixture in a bowl.
instructions.6: Shape the nuggets into pieces of about 30 g each.
instructions.7: Coat the nuggets in flour, then in the egg mixture, then in the crispy coating.
instructions.8: Fry the nuggets in oil until golden.
instructions.9: Keep the nuggets in the freezer if you want to store them longer.
instructions.10: Bake the potatoes in the oven for 5 minutes at 180°C.
instructions.11: Bake the nuggets in the oven at 180°C for 15 minutes, then flip them and bake for another 15 minutes.

fah-459.title: Roasted Potatoes with Bramley Cheese Dip
fah-459.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-459.culturalNotes: This recipe also works for school lunchboxes.

instructions.1: Wash the potatoes well, cut them in half, then cut each half into three pieces.
instructions.2: Boil the potatoes in water with a pinch of salt for 7 minutes.
instructions.3: Lift the potatoes out of the water and place them in a tray greased with oil or lined with parchment.
instructions.4: Sprinkle a pinch of pepper, paprika, and thyme over the potatoes.
instructions.5: Bake the tray at the highest temperature until the potatoes are browned.
instructions.6: While the potatoes roast, mix the Bramley cheese with the yogurt, a spoonful of thyme, and the olive oil.
instructions.7: Serve the crispy potatoes with the delicious dip.

fah-001.title: 3 Types of Kofta: Breaded Kofta, Rice Kofta & Hati Kofta
fah-001.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-001.culturalNotes: You can freeze the kofta on foam plates with a plastic bag between layers to stop them sticking. Let them come to room temperature before cooking.

instructions.1: Making the breaded kofta:
instructions.2: Mix the minced meat with the cooked rice, minced onion, chopped parsley, salt, pepper, meat spices, and instant bouillon.
instructions.3: Knead the mixture well until it holds together.
instructions.4: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
instructions.5: Dip the kofta in flour, then in the egg-and-milk mixture, then in the breadcrumbs, flour, and starch mixture.
instructions.6: Fry the kofta in hot oil over medium heat until golden.
instructions.7: Making the rice kofta:
instructions.8: Mix the minced meat with the ground rice, minced onion, garlic, mixed herbs, salt, pepper, cumin, ground coriander, and sugar.
instructions.9: Knead the mixture well until it holds together.
instructions.10: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
instructions.11: Fry the kofta in hot oil over medium heat until golden.
instructions.13: Mix the minced meat with the washed and drained bulgur, minced onion, chopped parsley, salt, pepper, meat spices, and instant bouillon.
instructions.14: Knead the mixture well for about 10 minutes until it holds together.
instructions.15: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
instructions.16: Grill the kofta on a grill pan, over charcoal, or in the oven until golden.

fah-002.title: Chicken Wings in Hot Buffalo Sauce
fah-002.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-002.culturalNotes: Reduce or remove the chili if you don't like spicy food. You can also serve the wings with a side salad or French fries.

instructions.1: Wash the wings well and soak them in water and vinegar for 10 minutes, then drain.
instructions.2: Mix the flour and starch with the salt, pepper, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.3: Pat the wings dry with a kitchen towel, then coat them well in the flour-and-starch mixture.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the wings until golden (about 15–20 minutes).
instructions.5: Drain the fried wings on a kitchen towel.
instructions.6: In another bowl, melt the butter, then add the tomato sauce, ketchup, molasses, soy sauce, sugar, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, black pepper, and chili (optional).
instructions.7: Stir the mixture over the heat until it thickens.
instructions.8: Add the fried wings to the sauce and toss until well coated.
instructions.9: Serve hot with side sauces of your choice.

fah-003.title: Steak with Mushroom Sauce
fah-003.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-003.culturalNotes: You can use a tenderloin cut instead of T-bone; it cooks faster.

instructions.1: Season the steak with salt and pepper on all sides.
instructions.2: Heat the butter in a pan over medium heat, add the steak slices, and sear until they take color on both sides.
instructions.3: After searing, cover the pieces with foil or a lid to keep them warm.
instructions.4: In the same pan, add the onion cut into small cubes and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add the garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the sliced mushrooms and stir until they shrink.
instructions.7: Add the salt and black pepper and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the flour and stir until well combined with the mushrooms.
instructions.9: Add the hot water and stir until the sauce thickens.
instructions.10: Add the cream and the bouillon and stir until the sauce is smooth.
instructions.11: Serve the steak with the mushroom sauce; it also goes well with grilled vegetables or white rice.

fah-004.title: Duck Stuffed with Freekeh
fah-004.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-004.culturalNotes: Serve the stuffed duck with a green salad or basmati rice. It keeps in the fridge for 2 days or can be frozen for a month.

instructions.1: Wash the duck and soak it in water, vinegar, and salt for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Rinse the duck and drain it.
instructions.3: Soak the freekeh in water for half an hour, then rinse and drain.
instructions.4: Cut the onion, tomatoes, carrot, and celery into small pieces.
instructions.5: In a pot, sauté the onion with the ghee, salt, pepper, and seven-spice.
instructions.6: Add the freekeh to the pot and stir it with the onion and spices.
instructions.7: Leave the mixture on the heat briefly until warmed through.
instructions.8: Let the mixture cool, then stuff the duck with it.
instructions.9: Close the duck opening with the liver and gizzards.
instructions.10: Prepare the marinade by mixing the ketchup with water and the spices.
instructions.11: Rub the duck with the marinade on the outside.
instructions.12: Place the duck in an oven bag with the vegetables and spices and seal the bag well.
instructions.13: Pierce the bag in 3–4 places and place it in a baking tray.
instructions.14: Put the tray in a preheated oven on high heat for half an hour.
instructions.15: Lower the oven temperature and leave the duck for 2–3 hours until cooked through.
instructions.16: Serve the duck with the freekeh cooked in the duck sauce.

fah-005.title: Traditional Tarab (Grilled Minced Meat in Caul Fat)
fah-005.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-005.culturalNotes: You can add onion and pepper while grilling for a lovely aroma. Tarab keeps in the fridge for 2 days or can be frozen for longer.

instructions.1: Prepare the minced meat: have the butcher grind the meat twice with 20% fat.
instructions.2: Prepare the onion: grate two large onions and squeeze them well.
instructions.3: Mix the ingredients: place the meat in a bowl and add the grated onion, salt, pepper, sugar, spices, and baking powder. Mix well until combined.
instructions.4: Prepare the caul fat: cut it into large squares.
instructions.5: Shape the tarab: take a portion of the meat mixture, shape it into a finger, and wrap the caul fat around it.
instructions.6: Prepare the skewers: thread the tarab onto skewers, making sure each piece is secure.
instructions.7: Grill: place the skewers on the rack over charcoal, leaving enough space to avoid burning. Turn the skewers regularly until the tarab takes a nice color and cooks through.
instructions.8: Serve: serve the tarab hot with parsley, grilled vegetables, and toasted bread.

fah-006.title: Turkish-Style Chicken
fah-006.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-006.culturalNotes: Add fresh herbs like parsley or fresh coriander for extra flavor. The chicken keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the onion and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the garlic, hot pepper, green pepper, and tomatoes, and stir for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Add the chicken bouillon, salt, black pepper, cinnamon, and dried coriander, and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the water and leave until it boils.
instructions.6: Add the chicken and let it cook for 40 minutes over low heat.
instructions.7: Add the raisins and green olives, and let it cook for another 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Serve the chicken hot with rice or bread.

fah-007.title: Browned Lung and Spleen (Fesha & Tehal)
fah-007.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-007.culturalNotes: Make sure the spleen and lungs are fresh, and wash them well before cooking. Serve with arugula and baladi bread for the best taste.

instructions.1: Wash the spleen and lungs and soak them in water for 10 minutes, then drain.
instructions.2: Place the spleen and lungs in a pot of boiling water, bring back to a boil, then drain.
instructions.3: Place the spleen and lungs in a clean pot, add boiling water, bay leaves, mastic, cardamom, salt, sugar, celery, carrot, tomato, and garlic, and let them cook until done.
instructions.4: Cut the spleen and lungs into slices.
instructions.5: In a pan, add the oil and stir the lungs for a minute, then add the garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the onion and stir for 3 minutes until softened.
instructions.7: Add the hot pepper and mixed peppers, and stir with the salt, dried coriander, black pepper, cumin, and spices.
instructions.8: Add the spleen to the pan and stir over the heat until browned, taking care of splattering oil.
instructions.9: Arrange the spleen and lungs over a bed of parsley.
instructions.10: Serve with arugula, baladi bread, and sandwiches.

fah-008.title: Saudi Kabsa with Daqqus Sauce
fah-008.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-008.culturalNotes: Daqqus keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve the kabsa with a green salad or yogurt.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over the heat, then add the chicken pieces and brown them well.
instructions.2: Add the finely chopped onion and stir until it takes a dark golden color.
instructions.3: Add the minced garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.4: Add the whole spices (salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, seven-spice, cloves, cardamom, black peppercorns, cinnamon, bay leaves).
instructions.5: Add the chicken pieces and toss with the spices, garlic, and onion.
instructions.6: Add the grated tomatoes, green pepper, and carrot, and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the water (2¼ cups) and bring to a boil.
instructions.8: Cover the pot and leave on low heat for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
instructions.9: Add the washed and drained basmati rice and stir well.
instructions.10: Cover the pot and leave on low heat until the rice is cooked.
instructions.11: In another bowl, add the chopped tomatoes, hot pepper, mint, minced garlic, coriander, chili, salt, black pepper, tomato sauce, vinegar, and water, and squeeze everything well together.
instructions.12: Transfer the daqqus to a bowl and set aside.
instructions.13: Add the lemon juice to the daqqus and stir well.
instructions.14: Serve the kabsa hot with the daqqus.

fah-009.title: El-Ghamrawi Kbeiba (Rice & Meat Balls in Broth)
fah-009.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-009.culturalNotes: Freeze the kbeiba after boiling on foam plates for later use; brown them in egg and milk or reheat when needed.

instructions.1: Mix the minced meat with the soaked, well-drained rice.
instructions.2: Add the parsley, dill, coriander, minced onion, garlic, salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, seven-spice, cinnamon, sugar, and instant bouillon.
instructions.3: Mix the ingredients well until combined.
instructions.4: Take a piece of the mixture and shape it into a kbeiba ball.
instructions.5: Arrange the kbeiba in a tray and coat them with oil.
instructions.6: Heat the oil in a pot and add onion slices, tomatoes, and peppers.
instructions.7: Add the kbeiba to the pot and cover them with boiling, salted broth.
instructions.8: Leave the pot on high heat for 10 minutes until it boils.
instructions.9: Lower the heat and let the kbeiba cook for an hour to an hour and a quarter.
instructions.10: After cooking, you can dip the kbeiba in egg and milk and fry them in oil.
instructions.11: Serve the kbeiba hot with fresh parsley.

fah-010.title: Cold Roast Beef
fah-010.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-010.culturalNotes: You can also serve the cold roast with seasoned rice. Leaving the roast in the fridge for a full day before serving gives the best flavor.

instructions.1: Prepare the roast with twine as Chef Fatma Abu Hati explained.
instructions.2: Wash the roast well and make slits in it with a thin knife.
instructions.3: Stuff the slits with the peppercorns, salt, whole peppers, ground pepper, tomatoes, onion, carrot, celery, thyme, and cardamom.
instructions.4: Season the outside of the roast with salt, ground pepper, thyme, and cardamom.
instructions.5: Leave the roast for half an hour to absorb the seasoning.
instructions.6: Heat a little oil in a tray on the stove and brown the roast on all sides until it takes a nice color.
instructions.7: Add the vegetables (onion, tomatoes, carrot, celery, bay leaves) to the tray.
instructions.8: Add two cups of boiling water, a teaspoon of sugar, and salt.
instructions.9: Cover the tray with aluminum foil and leave on low heat for an hour.
instructions.10: After an hour, turn the roast, cover again, and leave for another hour.
instructions.11: Let the roast cool, then refrigerate overnight.
instructions.12: The next day, slice the roast thinly.
instructions.13: For the vermicelli: cut the onion and colored peppers into small cubes.
instructions.14: Heat a little oil and ghee in a pot, add the vermicelli, and stir until golden.
instructions.15: Add the onion and colored peppers and stir with the vermicelli.
instructions.16: Add the water, salt, pepper, cinnamon, and the meat sauce, and leave until the vermicelli is cooked.
instructions.17: For the liver (optional): heat a little oil in a pot, add the liver, and stir until cooked.
instructions.18: Add the salt, pepper, and cinnamon and stir until done.
instructions.19: Serve the cold roast with the vermicelli and liver (if desired).

fah-011.title: Cold Meat Roast with Mixed Rice
fah-011.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-011.culturalNotes: Serve with nuts and sauce for a richer taste. The roast keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Trim the fat from the roast and tie it with cotton twine.
instructions.2: Season the roast with salt, pepper, and garlic.
instructions.3: Brown the roast in butter and oil on all sides.
instructions.4: Add the onion, celery, tomatoes, bay leaf, and hot water, and bring to a boil.
instructions.5: Turn the roast after an hour and let it cook for another hour.
instructions.6: Remove the roast and let it cool in the fridge for two to three hours.
instructions.7: Strain the sauce and blend part of it with the vegetables.
instructions.8: Return the sauce to the pan, add the flour, and stir until thickened.
instructions.9: Add the hot water, salt, pepper, and cinnamon, and bring to a boil.
instructions.10: Add the rice to the sauce, stir well, bring to a boil, then lower the heat and let it cook.
instructions.11: Add the raisins and let the rice finish cooking.
instructions.12: Sauté the liver in oil until its color changes and add the spices.
instructions.13: Remove the twine from the roast and cut it into slices.
instructions.14: Serve the cold roast with the rice, liver, and nuts.

fah-012.title: Sautéed Minced Meat (Easy & Delicious)
fah-012.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-012.culturalNotes: Prepare a large batch of seasoned minced meat before Ramadan and freeze it to save time and effort.

instructions.1: In a tray over the heat, put a spoonful of ghee and a little oil.
instructions.2: Add the minced onion and sauté until golden.
instructions.3: Add the minced meat and stir well with the onion until cooked.
instructions.4: Add a pinch of sugar, pepper, salt, cinnamon, and thyme, and stir well.
instructions.5: Leave the mixture until fully cooked.
instructions.6: Once cooked, let the meat cool completely.
instructions.7: Store the seasoned meat in freezer bags and use as needed.

fah-013.title: Palestinian Musakhan
fah-013.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-013.culturalNotes: Use taboon bread instead of baladi bread if available. You can add nuts for garnish and flavor.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken and clean it well inside and out.
instructions.2: Cut the chicken lengthwise and make slits with a knife so the marinade penetrates.
instructions.3: Cut the onions into wedges.
instructions.4: Add the olive oil, pomegranate molasses, sumac, black pepper, and salt to the onions and toss well.
instructions.5: Rub the chicken with the marinade and let it rest.
instructions.6: Place the chicken in a baking tray, add the tomato wedges and a little olive oil.
instructions.7: Cover the tray with parchment paper, then aluminum foil.
instructions.8: Bake at 220°C for two hours.
instructions.9: Once the chicken is out of the oven, arrange the baladi bread on the serving plate.
instructions.10: Pour the sauce of onions, olive oil, and sumac over the bread.
instructions.11: Garnish with pomegranate, coriander, lemon, and nuts as desired.

fah-014.title: Lebanese Mansaf
fah-014.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-014.culturalNotes: The rice keeps in the fridge for 2 days. Serve with tahini salad or grilled eggplant.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot, add the mastic and meat, and stir until well browned.
instructions.2: Add the tomatoes, carrot, minced onion, bay leaf, and ground cardamom, and stir together.
instructions.3: Add boiling water to cover the meat and leave on low heat until cooked through.
instructions.4: Add the salt and sugar, let it boil, then lower the heat and let it finish cooking.
instructions.5: In another pot, heat the ghee and oil, add the minced onion, and stir until softened.
instructions.6: Add the minced meat, cinnamon, bay leaf, and black pepper, and stir until the meat is browned.
instructions.7: Add the minced garlic and mix well.
instructions.8: Wash the rice, soak it for half an hour, drain, and add it to the minced meat.
instructions.9: Add the boiling broth to the rice and stir until the rice absorbs the liquid.
instructions.10: Cover the pot and cook on high heat for 5 minutes, then lower the heat until the rice is done.
instructions.11: Prepare the yogurt salad: place the yogurt in a fine strainer to drain.
instructions.12: Finely chop the mint and add it to the yogurt with the lemon juice, black pepper, and salt.
instructions.13: Add the olive oil, nuts, and coriander, and stir well.
instructions.14: Serve the rice with the boiled meat, nuts, coriander, and the yogurt salad.

fah-015.title: Budget Chicken Pane (Fake Pane)
fah-015.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-015.culturalNotes: Freeze the pane after shaping and fry when needed. Great for gatherings and very tasty.

instructions.1: Mince the onion in the food processor.
instructions.2: Add the chicken spices, salt, cumin, black pepper, and paprika. Mix well.
instructions.3: Add half a kilo of chicken (breasts or thighs) and mince it well with the other ingredients.
instructions.4: Transfer the mixture to a deep plate.
instructions.5: Add a cup of ground breadcrumbs and the mashed potato. Knead well until the mixture is firm and easy to shape.
instructions.6: Prepare the coating: mix 2 cups of breadcrumbs, half a cup of starch, a pinch of salt, a pinch of black pepper, coriander, cumin, and paprika.
instructions.7: Take a piece of the mixture, roll it into a ball, then press it into the coating.
instructions.8: Repeat until the mixture is used up.
instructions.9: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the pieces until golden.
instructions.10: Serve the pane on a bed of parsley.

fah-016.title: Crispy Spleen Pane
fah-016.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-016.culturalNotes: Serve the spleen pane with pasta or as sandwiches. You can add red or white sauce for serving.

instructions.1: Put the water in a pot over the heat until it boils.
instructions.2: Add the carrot, tomato, onion, celery, garlic, mastic, cardamom, bay leaf, and cloves to the boiling water.
instructions.3: Let the ingredients boil for a few minutes until fragrant.
instructions.4: Wash the spleen well with water and vinegar and let it dry.
instructions.5: Place the spleen in the boiling water and poach on low heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Remove the spleen from the water and let it cool.
instructions.7: Cut the spleen into pieces about 1 cm thick.
instructions.8: In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.9: In another bowl, mix the flour, starch, salt, black pepper, and spices as desired.
instructions.10: Dip the spleen pieces in the egg-and-milk mixture, then in the flour-and-starch mixture.
instructions.11: Fry the spleen pieces in hot oil over medium heat until golden and crispy.
instructions.12: Remove from the oil and drain on absorbent paper.
instructions.13: Serve the spleen pane with pasta or as sandwiches.
